qualifying_data_audit.sporting_cause: Drivers with crash in FP3/Q1, mechanical failure, or disqualified from session.

weather_data_audit.diagnosis: 2021 and 2022 have 100% weather telemetry; 2023 and 2024 are 0% cached in existing training matrix.

standard_weekends_coverage.typical_long_run_stints_per_driver: 1-2 stints of 8-15 laps on Medium/Hard tyres

season_2024.status: ELIMINATED BY FIA REGULATIONS (Replaced by Sprint Shootout and Sprint Race)

seasons_2021_2023.status: SATURDAY MORNING PARC FERME PRACTICE (Cars impounded; low setup relevance)
seasons_2021_2023.representative_pace_quality: Degraded / Low relevance due to frozen Parc Fermé setups

sprint_race_data_audit.prediction_cutoff_availability: On Sprint weekends, Saturday 100km Sprint Race finishes ~4 hours before GP Qualifying. Therefore, Sprint Race finishing position and racecraft pace are 100% pre-race available for the Grand Prix starting grid prediction stage (Cutoff S2 / S3).

data_sources_provenance_matrix.data_domain: Qualifying classification, Q1/Q2/Q3 times, Sprint race classification
data_sources_provenance_matrix.missing_data_reason: 1.0% missing reflects drivers crashing on out-laps or DNS without setting timed lap in Q1.
data_sources_provenance_matrix.prediction_cutoff_compliance: STRICTLY COMPLIANT. Published immediately upon qualifying completion.

data_sources_provenance_matrix.data_domain: FP1/FP2/FP3 lap-by-lap times, tyre compounds, tyre life, sector splits
data_sources_provenance_matrix.missing_data_reason: FP2 completely absent on 2024 sprint weekends (6 races). Practice sessions occasionally red-flagged or rained out. Drivers running fewer than 5 consecutive laps fail the long-run threshold.
data_sources_provenance_matrix.prediction_cutoff_compliance: STRICTLY COMPLIANT. Practice concludes 24h prior to Sunday race.
data_sources_provenance_matrix.quality_grade: EXPERIMENTAL PROTOCOL (Grade B+; Requires weekend format branching)

data_sources_provenance_matrix.data_domain: Air temperature, track temperature, humidity, rainfall indicator
data_sources_provenance_matrix.missing_data_reason: In historical training matrix, weather cache is populated for 2021-2022 (100%) but unpopulated for 2023-2024 (0%).
data_sources_provenance_matrix.prediction_cutoff_compliance: STRICTLY COMPLIANT when cached. Sourced during qualifying.
data_sources_provenance_matrix.quality_grade: PARTIAL / REQUIRES OFFLINE CACHE ENRICHMENT (Grade C)

data_sources_provenance_matrix.data_domain: Official Final Starting Grid, steward penalty notices, pit lane starts
data_sources_provenance_matrix.missing_data_reason: Unpublished during provisional stage; published 2-4 hours prior to lights out.
data_sources_provenance_matrix.prediction_cutoff_compliance: STRICTLY COMPLIANT for Official Grid stage; FORBIDDEN for Provisional stage.

conditional_format_features: fp2_long_run_median_pace (Available ONLY on standard weekends; 100% missing on 2024 sprint weekends)
sprint_race_pace_indicator (Available ONLY on sprint weekends; 100% missing on standard weekends)
audit_conclusions.recommendation: Paddock must implement a branched feature architecture. Standard weekends use FP2 long-run pace, while Sprint weekends branch to use Saturday Sprint Race pace. Attempting to fit a single monolithic FP2 feature across all 24 races will inject 25% missing values and degrade model stability.
